SELECT w.EditorID, edid(k.Value) AS Keyword
FROM Weapon w JOIN Weapon_Keywords k ON k.FormKey = w.FormKey
ORDER BY 1, k.Idx

SELECT Plugin, count(*) AS N FROM Weapon GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT Sig, count(*) AS N FROM Forms GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1
